seo_title: Custom B2B Sample Tracking Software for SMEs
seo_desc: Losing money on unreturned samples? We develop custom software and databases to track, manage, and recover your expensive B2B commercial samples.
author_pitch: As a Database Architect, I find it to be an absurd capital drain that manufacturers of ceramics, textiles, or construction materials send thousands of high-cost physical samples to architects and distributors without keeping strict control. Sending a sample case is a commercial investment, not a gift. I build relational databases and custom software that track every shipped piece, automate the return follow-up, and calculate the exact return on investment (ROI) of your sampling campaigns.
title: The sample sinkhole: Custom Software Development for B2B Sample Tracking
body:
Does your factory or distributorship lose tens of thousands of dollars a year sending physical sample cases to B2B clients who never return the material or end up buying?

In sectors such as ceramics, furniture, lighting, or textiles, sending technical samples to architects and large retailers is essential to close sales. The problem is that these briefcases and prototypes are expensive to manufacture. By managing them with an outdated Excel spreadsheet, the sales team loses track of who has which catalog. Months later, you have a financial hole in your marketing warehouse, you ignore which shipments have generated real sales, and you are forced to blindly manufacture more displays, destroying your budget.

The trap of Generic CRMs without Logistics Control

To try and solve this chaos, many sales directors force their team to log sample shipments in their standard CRM. However, these platforms are designed to track emails and calls, not to manage dynamic stock, return dates, or the reverse logistics of physical assets. Trying to control a rotating warehouse of expensive sample cases using the notes field of a CRM is guaranteeing the definitive loss of the material.

Our solution: Custom B2B Sample Tracking Software

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we connect your commercial effort with your factory's logistics. As software architects, we develop a relational database and a native web application designed specifically to orchestrate the complete life cycle of your corporate samples.

  1. Relational Display Structure: We design a centralized database that classifies each individual sample, kit, or display by its serial number, manufacturing batch, and unit production cost.
  2. Lightweight App for Sales Reps: We program an ultra-fast web interface so your salespeople can scan the sample's QR code with their mobile phone and automatically assign it to the visited client in just two seconds.
  3. Automated Reverse Logistics: The software monitors borrowing periods and sends automatic email alerts to both the client and the sales rep when the deadline to return the piece to the warehouse approaches.
  4. Per-Piece ROI Calculation: We link the sample system with your billing software to exactly calculate what percentage of the sent sample cases translates into signed orders, identifying the most profitable ones.

The Real Impact on your Corporate Acquisition Costs

  • Eradication of Material Misplacement: By having a digital responsible party and a return date for each piece, you stop giving away expensive assets and minimize the need to manufacture replacement samples.
  • Relentless Commercial Follow-Up: The automatic alerts force your salespeople to contact the prospect to pick up the sample, creating the perfect excuse to reopen the conversation and close the B2B sale.
  • Total Savings on SaaS Subscriptions: Because it is a custom-developed system hosted on your own server, you can give access to your hundred sales reps without paying monthly per-user fees.
